languageData.ATCore.label: Amor Tentaculum Core Principles
languageData.ATCore.description: Reveals the basic methods for cultivating your own tentacle creatures. This will allow you to craft an Amor Queen egg, which is the first step in converting your pawns into tentacle Hosts.
languageData.ATHostBasic.label: Basic Host Egg Production
languageData.ATHostBasic.description: Unlocks basic Host types and the eggs used to transform your pawns into them.
languageData.ATHostIntermediate.label: Intermediate Host Egg Produiction
languageData.ATHostIntermediate.description: Unlocks intermediate Host types and the eggs used to transform your pawns into them.
languageData.ATHostAdvanced.label: Advanced Host Egg Production
languageData.ATHostAdvanced.description: Unlocks advanced Host types and the eggs used to transform your pawns into them.
languageData.ATLarvaBasic.label: Basic Tentacle Larva Evolutions
languageData.ATLarvaBasic.description: Unlocks basic Tentacle types and the knowledge to trigger larvae to transform into them.
languageData.ATLarvaIntermediate.label: Intermediate Tentacle Larva Evolutions
languageData.ATLarvaIntermediate.description: Unlocks intermediate Tentacle types and the knowledge to trigger larvae to transform into them.
languageData.ATLarvaAdvanced.label: Advanced Tentacle Larva Evolutions
languageData.ATLarvaAdvanced.description: Unlocks advanced Tentacle types and the knowledge to trigger larvae to transform into them.
languageData.ATSummonFeral.label: Summon Feral Tentacles
languageData.ATSummonFeral.description: Learn how to lure feral tentacles to your colony. They will be hostile, so you will have to fight them off - but you can process their bodies into leather, meat, and other resources. This will also unlock the ability to summon advanced hybrid creatures, who will be a much more difficult threat, but can be analyzed to further your research.
languageData.ATBossBrewer.label: Brewer Research
languageData.ATBossBrewer.description: Analyze the genetic makeup of the Brewer to learn how to utilize its abilities, as well as create your own.
languageData.ATBossValkyrieDefender.label: Valkyrie/Defender Research
languageData.ATBossValkyrieDefender.description: Analyze the genetic makeup of the Valkyrie and Defender to learn how to utilize their abilities, as well as create your own.
languageData.ATBossWarWomb.label: War Womb Research
languageData.ATBossWarWomb.description: Analyze the genetic makeup of the War Womb to learn how to utilize its abilities, as well as create your own.
languageData.ATOvermind.label: Tentacle Overmind
languageData.ATOvermind.description: Unlocks the ability to transform your Amor Queen into an Overmind - an incredibly powerful psychic entity that will guarantee tentacular dominance over this RimWorld. (NOTE: Does not do anything yet, but will eventually unlock a victory challenge.)
languageData.ATStructBasic.label: Basic Tentacle Structures
languageData.ATStructBasic.description: Unlocks the ability to construct basic tentacle structures, using resources produced by your tentacluar colony.
languageData.ATStructUtility.label: Utility Tentacle Structures
languageData.ATStructUtility.description: Unlocks the ability to construct utility tentacle structures, using resources produced by your tentacluar colony.
languageData.ATStructDefense.label: Defensive Tentacle Structures
languageData.ATStructDefense.description: Unlocks the ability to construct defensive tentacle structures, using resources produced by your tentacluar colony.
languageData.ATImplantBasic.label: Basic Tentacle Implantation
languageData.ATImplantBasic.description: Unlocks the technology for implanting tentacles in (mostly) willing pawns.
languageData.ATImplantControl.label: Controlling Tentacle Implantation
languageData.ATImplantControl.description: Unlocks the technology for implanting tentacles in less-willing pawns, with the intent of controlling them or modifying their behavior.
languageData.ATImplantHost.label: Host Tentacle Implantation
languageData.ATImplantHost.description: Unlocks the technology for implanting tentacles in Amor Hosts, to further increase their power and abilities.
languageData.ATGearBasic.label: Basic Tentacle Gear
languageData.ATGearBasic.description: Unlocks the technology for crafting basic tentacle-specific gear, such as clothes.
languageData.ATGearArmor.label: Tentacle Armor
languageData.ATGearArmor.description: Unlocks the technology for crafting tentacle-specific armor for pawn protection. Note that these can be worn by Host types.
languageData.ATGearWeapon.label: Tentacle Weaponry
languageData.ATGearWeapon.description: Unlocks the technology for crafting tentacle-specific weapons. Note that these can be wielded by Host types.
